title: orchis incarnata var. latifolia
intro: Orchis incarnata var. latifolia, commonly known as the wide-leaved green orchis, is a flowering plant species within the orchid family. The wide-leaved green orchis has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Therapeutically, this plant has been used to treat various conditions, such as respiratory issues, skin irritations, and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of Orchis incarnata var. latifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
